name: kanban-estoque
description: Controle de Estoque Kanban - SaaS de controle de estoque com Kanban, RACI e previsoes ML

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.db:fresh: npm run db:reset && npm run db:migrate
scripts.render:start:backend: npm run migrate --prefix backend && npm start --prefix backend
scripts.render:build:frontend: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.validate: npm run test:unit --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
